purpose: Complete implementation-equivalence and timing audit on every completed phase05 development and transfer case

spec.purpose: Fresh closed-loop phase-gate development with full-candidate search and reference identity
spec.report_scope: All three fixed models and both tolerances; pointwise paired development intervals, no new risk certificate.
spec.timing_scope: Concurrent desktop workload; every complete call measured including phase forecasts; no deadline cutoff or hard-real-time claim.
spec.checks: Full original-reference trajectory identity; 50ms episode adoption subset of 100ms subset of original under error-free forecasts; all candidates and each distinct admitted bank independently reconstructed.
spec.selection_basis: Completed V20 exhaustive local screen and complete margin grid; no new study outcomes used.

spec.purpose: Matched-noise direct transfer of every fixed model and both phase gates
spec.report_scope: 32 independent initials per scenario; plants and controllers are paired, not independent samples. Pointwise descriptive intervals only; all failures retained.
spec.failure_scope: Incomplete vehicle arrival capped at 25s; no safety claim about motion after a simulation abort.
spec.selection_basis: Both fixed phase margins and all models, chosen before reading V21 phase-study outcomes; no winner selection.
spec.timing_scope: Concurrent desktop workload; no hard-real-time or isolated hardware timing claim.

selection: All 1536 phase and 1920 matched-transfer phase05 cases, all 3 fixed models, with every old failure; no outcome filtering
order: Alternate implementation order within each block; group ordering uses only original indices and scenario labels
warmup: Both implementations and all three fixed models on the same declared state before any timed episode
checks: Store row and full trace before assertions; compare every non-timing field including work and failure against paired implementation and independently reviewed archive; independently reconstruct every physical trace
failed_call_timing: External identical wrapper records every select call including the final exception; original gate_ms fields remain unchanged
timing_scope: Paired concurrent desktop measurements; full select calls and successful reported calls shown separately; no population quantile or hard-real-time claim
physical_scope: Original bounded-error assumptions unchanged; strong-lag violations and original aborts must reproduce, not be hidden or relabeled as safety
interruption: Exclusive creation and immutable seals; preserve any partial block and actual exits, never automatically restart
effects: No change to policy, candidate set, paths, prediction horizon, thresholds, reward, live calibration or publication acceptance
